BiblicalUsage: Mosad is a foundation — when God appointed the foundations of the earth, wisdom was there, and the psalmist says all the foundations of the earth are out of course when justice fails.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the foundations are moral before they are stone: when justice goes, the earth itself goes out of course.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
